name: gaps2-tech-prereq
description: Tech prerequisites (audit-gaps-2, off switch TI4_TECH_PREREQ / techPrereqGate). Rules (LRR 90 Technology): a player must satisfy a technology's prerequisites to research it; AI Development Algorithm: 'When you research a unit upgrade technology, you may exhaust this card to ignore any 1 prerequisite.' Ral Nel (pbd101 r1, owns only AI Development Algorithm, red) follows Technology, opens 'Get Other Technology' (which lists every technology) and picks War Sun (YRRR): refused (original: researched). Then PDS II (RY: AIDA's own red + AIDA's skip for Y) is accepted and AIDA is exhausted by the research (original: AIDA counted but stayed ready).
